claim: ISB detects more held malware than existing rule generators at the same low false-positive budget
passes_if: Higher family-macro TPR than every baseline at FP/1k ≤ 0.1; paired family-bootstrap CI excludes 0
if_not: Report the TPR–FP frontier and where ISB dominates it

claim: Learned selection adds detection beyond filtering and shorter rules
passes_if: Learned beats size-matched random-k and prevalence_k on F_test, CI excludes 0
if_not: Reframe as prevalence-ranked selection plus grammar plus gate (V1's learned arm lost to prevalence_k)

claim: Using the full YARA grammar beats hex-only and strings-only rules
passes_if: Higher TPR at equal FP/1k without more slow-rule warnings
if_not: Keep only the feature groups that add detection; report the rest as null results

claim: Packer-aware selection removes false positives on packed goodware
passes_if: Lower FP/1k on natural-packed and self-packed goodware at equal TPR
if_not: Report per packer; claim only where it holds

claim: The gains are not an artifact of YARA-derived labels
passes_if: C1–C2 deltas keep their sign within CI on the confirmed subset; circularity probe shows no concentration on rule-matched samples
if_not: Present Tier X results as an upper bound and say so in the abstract

claim: A repair ladder keeps ISB near its starting quality for less than full retraining
passes_if: TPR stays within the starting CI at FP/1k ≤ 0.1 across windows, at fewer GPU-hours than full retraining
if_not: Report the drift rate and the retraining point only
